## related

Using the package related, I will first calculate pairwise relatedness. This package can handle both bi-allelic and multi-allelic data, so that we maintain all original complexity.

However, related doesn't run in new versions of R. Instead, it requires R version 4.3.3.

```{r}
install.packages("related", repos = "http://R-Forge.R-project.org")
```
